Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What is The Role 
 We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own how Elastic Security is packaged, priced, and sold on Elastic Cloud Serverless. 
 More customers want to run SIEM, endpoint, and cloud security on Serverless, and the commercial model decides whether that growth is profitable. You will own the security solution layer on top of the Serverless platform: the tiers, the meters, the margins, and what it is like for a customer to pay for security on a consumption model. The Platform team owns the underlying architecture. You will work with them so that what we sell can be delivered at a healthy margin and quoted with confidence. 
 We are changing how we price and package, and you will help design the new model. You own the pricing recommendation, and executive executive team makes the final call. 
 The role sits between Product, Finance, Engineering, Sales, and Product Marketing. Expect to explain to a CISO, a CFO, and a field seller why a SKU looks the way it does. 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Redesign how Security is packaged and priced on Serverless. Define the tiers, feature entitlements, and usage meters, select what is bundled, metered, or sold as an add-on, test the options against customer demand and COGS, and bring a recommendation to senior executive team. 
 Own margin. Work with the Platform team and Finance to model the cost of new security capabilities, including ingest, search, retention, endpoint, and AI features, and set pricing requirements before a feature ships. 
 Grow Security on Serverless from proof of concept to renewal. You are accountable for new workloads, migrations from hosted and self-managed deployments, expansion, and retention. Work with Finance to separate recurring growth from one-time proof-of-concept revenue. 
 Give customers control over cost and performance. Define how search configurations, data tiers, and retention work for security use cases, and bring the cost models that justify new platform levers. Keep tenant-level packaging consistent with the Product Manager for MSSP and multi-tenancy. 
 Simplify how customers understand cost. Cut packaging complexity first, then simplify the sizing and pricing estimators that customers and Solutions Architects use. Agree on a measure of "simple," such as time to a credible quote, and track it. 
 Turn pricing decisions into shipped product. Write the PRDs and PRFAQs, and lead the work across Security engineering, the Serverless Platform team, Billing and Metering, and Cloud Operations. Help build the frameworks and reviews that other Security PMs, Product Marketing, and Solutions Architects use to price new capabilities. 
 Stay close to the market and the field. Discuss with customers and prospects about what they will and won't pay for, track how other security platforms package and price, and help the field explain when Serverless, hosted, or self-managed is the right fit. 
 You know the main approaches to pricing AI features, such as token-based, credit-based, and per-action or outcome pricing, and how inference costs and unpredictable usage shape each one. 
 What You Bring 
 You have led pricing and packaging for a SaaS or cloud product end to end, from option design and customer testing through margin modeling and executive approval, and you can point to the revenue, margin, or adoption result. Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing is required, as is experience simplifying a model that had grown too complex. 
 Product experience with SIEM, XDR, endpoint, cloud security, or a security operations platform is a solid plus, and so is a background as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. If your pricing work was on another cloud or data product, the team will help you learn the security side. 
 You are comfortable with COGS, gross margin, and ARR modeling, and you can build a forecast with Finance without a translator. 
 You understand how multi-tenant cloud services are built and how architecture choices drive cost, well enough to read a technical design. 
 You lead through influence in a matrixed, remote-first company. You get enable teams to agree on a decision, work well asynchronously, and shift between priorities when the business changes. 
 You can present pricing to a CISO and a procurement team, and you have supported deals as the product expert. 
 You write PRDs, pricing proposals, and executive summaries that people act on. You use AI tools to improve pricing analysis and cost modeling, and you own the output. 
 You have 7 to 10 years in product management, including significant time on security or cloud data products. Experience at a security vendor, a cloud data platform, or a company that moved customers from licensed to consumption pricing is a plus. 
 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. 
 These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future. 
 An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
 Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

 $154,000 — $243,600 CAD 
 Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People 
 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
 We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.



The Role

This is a 0-to-1 role: part strategist, part builder, part entrepreneur, managing a small team. You'll design and launch the next generation of advice experiences, prove they work, and hand off proven playbooks to our sales and service teams to own and scale.

Your scope is the whole of Wealthsimple's advice business, not a single client segment. This role lives at the intersection of sales, service, product innovation, and commercial execution, and it exists to answer one question: what does a truly differentiated, human-centred advice experience look like at Wealthsimple, and how do we prove it works before we scale it?



Your Impact

Define what "5-star" client experiences look like in wealth management. Draw on deep knowledge of premium service (elite financial services) to design client experiences that are differentiated. You'll set the bar for what every advice client can expect from Wealthsimple, and you'll do it by building real things with real clients.

Incubate and personally run new advice services. Take a concept, like a new advice offering, an estate concierge, or a high-touch onboarding experience, and figure out how to deliver the MVP before it's ready to be scaled. The innovation is in designing a client experience that is truly differentiated and, through the use of technology & AI, highly scalable. When it works, you package it into a playbook and hand it to sales or service teams to run at scale. You own the incubation and inform the scaled delivery.

Build the advisor tooling that makes advice better and faster. Work hand-in-hand with product teams and advisors to take advisor tooling from manual to automated. You set the requirements, translate advisor reality into product specs, and work with other leaders to drive adoption.

Stay ahead of where the industry is going. You're plugged into the evolving advice and wealth landscape, the startups, the disruptors, and the best incumbents globally. You bring that intelligence back and help us sharpen hypotheses about what to build next, complemented by a close read of what our own clients value and where they feel under-served.

Prove commercial impact. Every pilot is measured against clear metrics, AUM growth, conversion, and client satisfaction. You design experiments that prove value before we commit to scaling, and you make backed recommendations on what to accelerate, refine, or sunset.



What You'll Do

 - Work directly with and senior leadership to shape the future of Wealthsimple's advice offering

 - Launch and personally run the first iterations of services that will eventually reach hundreds of thousands of clients

 - Shape Wealthsimple's digital advice roadmap from the front line. Our advisors talk to clients every day, you turn what you hear into validated demand signals for product teams.



We're Looking for Someone Who

 - Is energized by the messy, creative, manual work of building something from nothing, and doesn't need a large team or perfect infrastructure to get a pilot off the ground

 - Has a genuine obsession with how the wealth and fintech landscape is evolving globally, with sharp instincts for real shift versus noise

 - Brings deep knowledge of what premium service actually feels like from a client's perspective, and can translate it into a wealth management context

 - Thinks commercially: you build experiences, but you always know the business case and how you'll prove it

 - Is a natural leader who can bring stakeholders together around a shared vision

 - Is tech-forward: comfortable with AI tools, low-code platforms, and lightweight scripting to build functional prototypes that test real concepts in market

 - Is the person who notices the detail nobody asked for, and arrives with ideas about what would make a client tell their friends about us



What You'll Bring

 - 5-7+ years in service design, strategy, innovation, or premium client experience (ideally with exposure to HNW or complex client segments)

 - A proven track record of taking a service concept from idea to live pilot (true 0-to-1 experience)

 - Demonstrated ability to use modern technology, AI tools, low-code/no-code, or lightweight scripting, to rapidly prototype and test

 - Experience working alongside scaled operational teams and transitioning pilots into standardized processes, with a clear ability to hand off and let go

 - Familiarity with the wealth management landscape: how different advice models work, what HNW clients value, and how firms grow AUM

 - Comfort working in regulated environments and partnering with compliance teams

 - Outstanding communication skills: you can influence executives, inspire advisors, and earn the trust of external partners




WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles. 




ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.



Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.



Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.



AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

 Entreprise familiale fondée en 1953, Lamour Inc. s’est forgé une solide réputation comme référence en matière de bas, vêtements de performance, bonneterie et lingerie. Nous faisons partie des 5 plus grands acteurs mondiaux dans les essentiels d’activewear, sommes le leader mondial du vêtement sans couture, et l’un des principaux fabricants de bas au Canada.
 En tant que guichet unique, nous travaillons avec innovation et passion afin d’offrir une qualité exceptionnelle et une grande valeur ajoutée à une clientèle internationale diversifiée. Notre succès repose sur notre expertise en technologies de tissus de performance, notre capacité d’innovation produit, nos investissements en excellence manufacturière, notre rapidité d’exécution, ainsi que la performance de notre chaîne d’approvisionnement, nous permettant de bâtir des partenariats solides, durables et significatifs à travers plusieurs réseaux de distribution.
 Le manutentionnaire – réception et déchargement est responsable de la réception sécuritaire des conteneurs, du déchargement des marchandises à partir des camions et de la préparation des produits pour l’inventaire ou l’entreposage. Ce rôle pratique est essentiel pour assurer des opérations fluides et efficaces au sein du centre de distribution.
 Principales responsabilités : 
 Recevoir les conteneurs entrants et vérifier les documents à leur arrivée.
 Décharger les marchandises des conteneurs en utilisant des techniques et des équipements appropriés.
 Trier, organiser et empiler les produits sur des palettes ou des chariots.
 Inspecter les articles afin de détecter tout dommage, manque ou problème de qualité et signaler les écarts au superviseur.
 Déplacer les marchandises vers les zones de réception ou de préparation désignées à l’aide de transpalettes manuels ou électriques.
 Maintenir un environnement de travail propre, sécuritaire et bien organisé.
 Respecter les procédures de sécurité et porter l’équipement de protection individuelle (EPI) en tout temps.
 Participer aux tâches générales d’entrepôt au besoin (ex. : emballage, nettoyage, gestion des déchets, soutien à l’inventaire).
 Communiquer efficacement avec les superviseurs et les membres de l’équipe.
 Qualifications : 
 Une expérience préalable en entrepôt ou en réception est un atout.
 Bonne condition physique et capacité à soulever régulièrement jusqu’à 50 lb (23 kg).
 Fiabilité, ponctualité et aisance dans un environnement de travail rapide.
 Connaissance de base des pratiques de sécurité en entrepôt.
 Capacité à suivre des instructions verbales et écrites.
 Compétences de base en communication en anglais (le français est un atout au Québec).
 Expérience avec des transpalettes ou d’autres équipements de manutention (un atout).
 Conditions de travail : 
 Travail effectué dans un centre de distribution.
 Nécessite de rester debout, de soulever des charges, de se pencher et d’effectuer des mouvements répétitifs durant le quart de travail.
 Peut inclure des horaires variables (tôt le matin, le soir ou la fin de semaine).
 ---
 Family-owned since 1953, Lamour Inc. has earned a reputation for being the best choice in socks, performance apparel, hosiery and lingerie. In fact, we're among the world's top 5 players in activewear basics, the world's leading manufacturer of seamless garments, and one of Canada's leading sock manufacturers. 
 As a one-stop shop, we work innovatively and passionately to deliver exceptional quality and value to a diverse international customer base. It's our focus on performance fabric technology and product innovation, investment in manufacturing excellence, speed-to-market and supply chain execution that enables us to build meaningful, strong and sustainable retail partnerships across multiple trade channels.
 Position Summary:  
 The Material Handler – Receiving & Unloading  is responsible for safely receiving containers, unloading merchandise from trucks, and preparing goods for inventory, or storage. This hands-on role is essential to ensuring smooth and efficient operations within the distribution center. 
 Key Responsibilities:  
 Receive incoming containers and verify documentation upon arrival. 
 Unload goods from containers using proper lifting techniques and equipment. 
 Sort, organize, and stack products onto pallets or carts. 
 Inspect items for damage, shortages, or quality concerns and report discrepancies to the supervisor. 
 Move merchandise to designated receiving or staging areas using manual or electric pallet jacks. 
 Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area. 
 Follow safety procedures and wear appropriate PPE at all times. 
 Assist with general warehouse duties as required (e.g., packaging, sweeping, waste disposal, inventory support). 
 Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members. 
 Qualifications:  
 Previous experience in a warehouse or receiving role is an asset. 
 Physically fit and able to lift up to 50 lbs (23 kg) consistently. 
 Reliable, punctual, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. 
 Basic knowledge of warehouse safety practices. 
 Ability to follow verbal and written instructions. 
 Basic communication skills in English (French is an asset in Quebec). 
 Experience with pallet jacks or material handling equipment is a plus.
 Working Conditions:  
 Work is performed in a distribution centre environment. 
 Requires standing, lifting, bending, and repetitive motion throughout the shift. 
 May involve shift work, including early mornings, evenings, or weekends.

Veiller à l’application et à la mise à jour des normes et procédures liées à l’accès aux immeubles et aux mesures d’urgence tout en répondant promptement aux besoins des employés afin de leur offrir un environnement de travail conforme et sécuritaire.

 Environnement de travail

 Diplôme d’études collégiales avec spécialisation en techniques administratives ou dans une autre spécialisation pertinente.

 Déplacements occasionnels requis.

 Connecte avec tes collègues  : Travaille de la maison jusqu’à trois jours par semaine et profite de l’énergie du bureau pour créer, t’inspirer, collaborer et avoir du plaisir!  
 Plusieurs formules d’horaires flexibles te permettant de mieux concilier vie personnelle et professionnelle, tout en respectant ton profil d’emploi. 
 Allonge tes journées de travail pendant quatre jours pour obtenir une demi-journée de congé. 
 Évite le trafic en réalisant tes 7 heures de travail entre 7 h 30 et 18 h.   
 Profite de congés payés un vendredi après-midi sur deux durant l’été 
 Bénéficie de 2 semaines complètes en télétravail au Québec par année 
 Dépasse-toi : Plusieurs options te sont offertes pour parfaire tes connaissances, améliorer tes compétences professionnelles ou tes habiletés de gestion. S’ajoutent à cela des congés pour études, le remboursement des frais pour l’obtention d’une attestation professionnelle, le remboursement de matériel de cours, et encore plus. 
 Prends soin de ta santé : Nous offrons des services de télémédecine tout à fait gratuitement. Notre programme de santé-mieux-être TonIQ, te permet également de profiter de conférences et de suggestions d’activités favorisant un bel équilibre de vie. 
 Reste actif : Nous remboursons une partie des frais d’inscription à ton programme de santé physique. 
 Sens-toi soutenu en toutes circonstances : Notre programme d’aide aux employés et à la famille t’apporte un soutien gratuit, immédiat et confidentiel. 
 Réalise-toi maintenant et prépare ton avenir en même temps!  Nos employés adhèrent automatiquement à notre régime de retraite à prestations déterminées, l’un des plus généreux de notre secteur d’activité.  
 Sois rassuré, tu seras assuré Nous offrons un régime d’assurances collectives flexibles pouvant être modulés en fonction des besoins (selon admisibilité) .
 Vois la vie en vert Plusieurs initiatives en développement durable s’ajoutent à notre bilan chaque année : remboursement d’une partie de tes titres de transport, stationnement à vélos gratuit, distributrices à eau pour éviter le gaspillage de plastique

The Company 
 Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond . We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments. 
 When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades. 
 AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it. 
 This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real. 
 The Role 
 The Senior Demand Generation Manager is responsible for driving sustainable long-term pipeline growth and market engagement across Versaterm’s portfolio of public safety solutions. This role leads high-complexity, cross-departmental initiatives through expertise and influence, and brings deep functional and technical mastery of demand generation. The Senior Demand Generation Manager frequently represents the marketing function in cross-departmental and external engagements, contributes directly to decisions that shape the direction of the area, mentors others, and actively champions Versaterm’s values across the teams and work they influence.
 What You Do 
 Designs and plans targeted go-to-market programs to build brand awareness and generate and nurture leads through the sales and marketing funnel.
 Owns the strategy and execution of demand generation programs that drive qualified pipeline and revenue growth.
 Defines and develops new demand generation approaches, frameworks, and best practices that raise the standard across the function.
 Leverages digital platforms to automate marketing activities, including webinars, and determines the most effective points of interaction (POI) for marketing campaigns.
 Utilizes Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, customer information, and marketing automation platforms like Marketo and SFDC to create and deploy effective marketing campaigns.
 Partners with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to guide messaging, positioning, and content strategy, ensuring go-to-market alignment, optimizing campaign performance, and supporting product launches and market expansion.
 Drives the creative development of content and communications that support demand generation campaigns and customer engagement, and optimizes ROI by establishing KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure campaign effectiveness and inform decisions.
 Leads high-complexity, cross-departmental initiatives, ensuring alignment and execution against company goals and growth objectives.
 Manages demand generation program spend, recommending investments that maximize ROI and scalability.
 Creates a rolling calendar of campaigns that align to Sales leadership and Product pipeline goals.
 Delivers a consistent experience for the Sales team with campaigns that are fully developed with content, lists, decks, and enablement to execute to plan.
 Represents the demand generation function in cross-departmental and external engagements and contributes directly to decisions that shape the direction of the area.
 Mentors colleagues across Marketing and partner teams, driving a culture of learning and continuous improvement.
 What You Bring 
 Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, with deep, recognized expertise and authority in demand generation.
 Proven success building and scaling demand generation programs in a high-growth SaaS environment.
 Strong understanding of public safety or mission-driven technology markets is a plus.
 Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence at all levels of the organization without direct authority.
 Deep mastery of marketing automation, CRM, and analytics platforms (e.g., Marketo, SFDC), with experience establishing KPIs and reporting frameworks.
 Exceptional communication, analytical, and mentoring skills, with a record of raising the standard for the function.
 Note: T his position requires a security clearance from the Government of Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada and must successfully obtain and maintain a Reliability security clearance. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on the Government of Canada's security screening process, please visit Public Services and Procurement Canada . About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!





Why we're looking for you
Owner helps restaurants run and grow their businesses online. Our product is moving quickly, and the opportunity is not simply to announce more features. It is to make every important product investment easier to sell, easier to adopt, and more valuable to the restaurants that use it.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can connect product velocity to commercial impact. You will help our frontline teams win the right customers, retain the customers we have, and clearly explain why Owner is the better choice. You will turn customer and market insight into positioning, proof, enablement, adoption programs, and feedback that shapes what we build next.

This is a GTM-focused role. Launches and communications are tools in the system, not the outcome by themselves. The outcome is stronger win rates, healthier retention, better adoption, and a frontline team that can confidently make the value of Owner clear.

This role is fully remote and can be based in the United States or Canada.

The impact you'll have
Build positioning, messaging, proof points, battlecards, talk tracks, objection handling, and customer stories that improve competitive win rates.

 - Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Support to understand what helps them close, onboard, adopt, retain, and expand customers.

 - Identify adoption blockers and churn risks, then turn product capabilities into practical retention and expansion plays.

 - Create scalable enablement systems and workflows that keep the frontline current without relying on one more training session.

 - Bring win/loss insight, customer feedback, competitive context, and adoption signals into Product and Marketing planning.

 - Define the audiences and customer behaviors that matter most for priority capabilities, then build GTM programs that move those behaviors.

 - Partner with Product early to clarify the customer problem, sharpen the value proposition, and make the eventual GTM motion stronger before development is complete.

 - Use launches, customer communications, in-product moments, and other channels selectively when they drive a measurable customer or commercial outcome.

 - Use AI to increase the speed and quality of research, content creation, analysis, and enablement while maintaining a high bar for accuracy.
   

Who you'll work with

 - The VP of Marketing and Product Marketing team.

 - Product and EPD partners, from early discovery through rollout.

 - Enablement, Sales, Customer Success, and Support.

 - Customer Marketing, Growth Marketing, Community, and Brand/Events.



What we're looking for

 - 3+ years of experience in product marketing, go-to-market, sales enablement, customer marketing, or a closely related role in technology.

 - A track record of improving a commercial or customer outcome, such as win rate, adoption, retention, expansion, or frontline effectiveness.

 - Experience turning complex product capabilities into clear positioning and practical tools for customer-facing teams.

 - Strong customer and market judgment. You can connect objections, competitive dynamics, customer needs, and churn or adoption signals to what the business should do next.

 - A systems mindset. You build repeatable workflows that scale with product velocity and make it easier for teams to do the right thing.

 - Excellent writing and presentation skills. You can make a value proposition compelling and a frontline asset immediately useful.

 - Comfort working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Marketing.

 - An AI-forward approach to your work. You actively use AI to move faster without sacrificing accuracy, judgment, or customer empathy.



How we'll evaluate your work

As part of the process, you will work through a practical scenario involving a priority product capability with an adoption or competitive win-rate challenge. We will ask you to diagnose the problem, identify the target audience, develop the positioning and frontline plays, propose a focused rollout, and define how you would measure impact.

Pay and benefits

The estimated base salary range for this role is $155,000 - $165,000 USD, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package.

Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, a remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO, and additional perks.





Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.



We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

À titre d’organisation de gestion de patrimoine de premier plan, nous nous engageons à faire preuve de leadership, d’innovation et de responsabilité ainsi qu’à miser sur le partenariat et la communauté. En travaillant avec des professionnels talentueux et énergiques qui incarnent nos valeurs au quotidien, vous constaterez rapidement que ce sont nos employés et notre culture « uneaviso » dynamique qui nous démarquent des autres sociétés. Si vous êtes à la recherche d’un emploi intéressant et stimulant au sein d’une entreprise centrée sur son personnel, découvrez ce que Aviso peut vous offrir en consultant le site www.aviso.ca/fr .
 L’occasion: 
 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un superviseur ou d’une superviseure des transferts bilingue qui se joindra à notre équipe de l’Exploitation.
 Relevant du gestionnaire ou de la gestionnaire, Exploitation, le superviseur ou la superviseure des transferts bilingue est responsable de superviser l’équipe chargée des transferts, de gérer les volumes de travail et de veiller au respect des échéances quotidiennes. Les responsabilités de supervision comprennent le recrutement, la formation, l’encadrement, le mentorat et l’établissement des horaires du personnel, y compris la supervision de l’accueil et de l’intégration des nouveaux employés ainsi que l’évolution de carrière et les possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel.
 En tant qu’uneaviso : 
 Nous prenons soin de vous – Vous faites ce qu’il faut pour la clientèle, les partenaires et les collègues. Vous établissez des relations de confiance, prônez l’excellence du service et contribuez à une culture où chaque personne se sent valorisée et soutenue. 
 Nous osons – Vous remettez en question le statu quo au moyen d’idées audacieuses et de nouvelles perspectives. Vous accueillez le changement, recherchez des occasions d’innovation et êtes à l’aise avec l’exploration de nouvelles méthodes de travail. 
 Nous nous surpassons – Vous collaborez ouvertement et établissez des relations significatives. Vous recherchez des points de vue variés, partagez vos connaissances et travaillez de concert avec les collègues, la clientèle et les partenaires pour les aider à réussir. 
 Nous livrons des résultats – Vous assumez la responsabilité de votre travail, respectez vos engagements et vous concentrez sur la production de résultats concrets. Vous êtes responsable de vos actions et cherchez constamment à vous améliorer. 
 À quoi ressemble votre journée: 
 Fixer des normes pour les procédures du service et en effectuer le suivi, en vue d’assurer la qualité, l’exactitude et l’efficacité du travail dans le respect des contrats de niveau de service
 Créer un climat positif et empreint de leadership en gagnant le respect du personnel, des pairs et des parties intéressées
 S’assurer que les membres du personnel bénéficient d’une formation et d’un perfectionnement appropriés en temps opportun
 Encadrer le personnel en vue d’améliorer le rendement tout en augmentant/maintenant l’engagement des employés ainsi que leur avancement professionnel, et soutenir l’accueil et l’intégration des nouveaux employés
 Veiller à ce que tous les processus et toutes les procédures soient à jour dans tous les manuels – internes et externes, y compris les contrats de niveau de service du service
 Se charger des communications internes et externes en suivant les canaux de distribution appropriés, en faisant la liaison avec les fournisseurs externes et les fiduciaires, le cas échéant
 Analyser les pratiques commerciales actuelles et cerner les domaines dans lesquels le service peut améliorer ses processus, faire des recommandations et mettre en place des procédures pour rationaliser le flux de travail
 Gérer le travail lié aux projets du service et participer à la mise en œuvre d’initiatives du service et de la division, selon les besoins, et déléguer si nécessaire
 Appuyer le personnel dans le cadre de problèmes complexes ou transmis à un échelon supérieur, répondre à toutes les demandes de renseignements des clients (internes et externes) et veiller à ce que les niveaux de service à la clientèle soient maintenus au sein du service, en informant la direction, le cas échéant
 Prévoir les effectifs appropriés ainsi que les besoins de formation et de perfectionnement, y compris la formation polyvalente du personnel de sorte que les employés soient à jour et puissent s’acquitter des tâches exigées dans le cadre de chacun des postes au sein de l’équipe
 Examiner et approuver les écritures de journal quotidiennes et les rapprochements de compte mensuels (OCRCVM et ACCFM)
 Rendre compte tous les mois, en temps opportun, des normes prévues par les contrats de niveau de service, y compris les exceptions, et créer des plans d’affaires pour gérer les ressources en cas de volumes élevés
 Se tenir au courant des initiatives et des normes du secteur (ACCFM et OCRCVM) et actualiser ses connaissances sur les produits de régimes enregistrés, le service NELTC de la CDS, les règles de l’OCRCVM et de l’ACCFM, les lois et les protocoles
 Faire la liaison avec la direction en ce qui concerne les rapports sur les processus et les procédures destinés aux vérificateurs externes et internes, selon les besoins
 Requirements 
 Expérience et compétences demandées : 
 Études postsecondaires et formation continue en lien avec le secteur des placements, plus précisément les fonctions liées aux opérations 
 Connaissance approfondie des exigences réglementaires pertinentes, et CFIC ou CCVM suivi avec succès, un atout
 De trois à cinq ans d’expérience à des niveaux de responsabilité de plus en plus élevés dans le secteur des placements, dont un à deux ans dans un rôle de supervision
 Excellentes compétences en matière de délégation, d’organisation, de gestion du temps et d’administration
 Grand souci du détail et de l’exactitude
 Capacité à travailler sous pression, à établir des priorités et à respecter les contraintes de temps
 Solides compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes, et capacité de gérer plusieurs tâches tout en ayant le souci du détail
 Excellentes aptitudes pour le service à la clientèle et capacité à rapidement cerner et résoudre les problèmes d’une manière satisfaisante pour toutes les parties
 Grande motivation, notamment pour l’atteinte des objectifs
 Connaissances informatiques intermédiaires en MS Word, Excel, Outlook et Access. Des compétences avancées sur Excel sont un atout
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication, à la fois en français et en anglais, requises
 Benefits 
 Pourquoi Aviso Wealth ? 
 Chez Aviso Wealth, vous trouverez une culture dynamique et inclusive qui valorise l’innovation et met en valeur les réussites de ses employés.
 Quelques traits qui nous distinguent : 
 Un programme de rémunération concurrentiel qui récompense et valorise les contributions de chacun.
 Des prestations de santé, soins dentaires et une assurance de premier plan pour satisfaire les divers besoins de nos employés
 Des vacances généreuses, des bénéfices de santé et de conditionnement physique, des options complémentaires au congé parental.
 Des cotisations complémentaires pour notre programme de retraite.
 Un engagement à l’amélioration continue de notre personnel au moyen de l’apprentissage et du développement ainsi que d’un programme de soutien à la formation.
 Des événements sociaux organisés régulièrement pour favoriser le travail d’équipe.
 Vos renseignements 
 En soumettant votre candidature, vous consentez à la collecte, à l’utilisation et à la communication des renseignements personnels que vous avez fournis dans le but d’évaluer vos qualifications et votre aptitude à occuper un emploi à Aviso. Vos renseignements seront traités conformément aux lois canadiennes sur la protection des renseignements personnels applicables, notamment la Loi sur la protection des renseignements personnels et les documents électroniques (LPRPDE) et les lois provinciales pertinentes. Vos données peuvent être communiquées au personnel autorisé participant au processus de recrutement et ne seront conservées que pendant la durée nécessaire à ces fins ou conformément à la loi.
 Pour obtenir plus d’informations, consultez le lien sur la Politique de protection des renseignements personnels , qui se trouve sur notre page Carrières.
 Politique d’égalité d’accès à l’emploi 
 Aviso accueille et encourage les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées, y compris les candidats/titulaires handicapés. Si vous nécessitez un accommodement, nous travaillerons avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins à toutes les étapes du processus d’embauche.
 Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt, cependant, seules les candidatures retenues pour une étude plus approfondie seront contactées.
 Aucun recruteur ou agence, s’il vous plaît.
 Aperçu de la société 
 Fort d’un actif total sous administration et sous gestion environ 145 milliards de dollars, et d’un effectif de plus de 1 000 employés, Aviso est un important fournisseur de services de gestion de patrimoine et de placement pour le secteur financier canadien. Nous bâtissons un écosystème complet de services de gestion de patrimoine à la fine pointe de la technologie et axé sur les clients. Nos clients comprennent nos partenaires, les conseillers et les investisseurs. Nous sommes un partenaire de confiance pour presque toutes les coopératives d’épargne et de crédit au Canada, en plus de l’être pour un large éventail de gestionnaires de portefeuille, de courtiers en placement, de compagnies d’assurance, de sociétés de fiducie et de courtiers remisiers. Nos partenaires comptent sur Aviso pour leur offrir des solutions bien précises qui leur procurent un avantage concurrentiel dans un secteur en pleine évolution et hautement compétitif. Notre courtier en placement, notre courtier en épargne collective et nos services d’assurance soutiennent des milliers de conseillers en placement. Notre gestionnaire d’actifs est Placements NEI, dont la spécialisation est d’investir de façon responsable. Notre service de courtage en ligne, Qtrade Investissement directMD, renforce le pouvoir des investisseurs autonomes, et notre service de placement entièrement automatisé, Portefeuilles accompagnés QtradeMD, est au service des investisseurs qui préfèrent une approche passive. Partenaires des correspondants Aviso offre des services de garde de biens et de courtier chargé de compte à un large éventail de sociétés. Nous avons des bureaux à Toronto, Vancouver, Montréal et Winnipeg. Aviso est soutenue par la force collective de ses propriétaires : les centrales de caisses de crédit, Co-operators/CUMIS et Desjardins. Nous sommes fiers de propulser les entreprises qui renforcent le pouvoir des investisseurs. 
 Faire carrière à Aviso, c’est faire partie d’un groupe de professionnels talentueux et énergiques qui vivent leurs valeurs au quotidien, et appartenir à une organisation qui se consacre à votre réussite et au développement de votre carrière. Si vous êtes à la recherche d’un travail intéressant et stimulant au sein d’une société soucieuse de son personnel, postulez pour faire partie de notre équipe!
 Salaire 
 L’échelle salariale prévue de ce poste est de 83 000 $ à 100 000 $ CA par année. Les conditions de rémunération individuelles sont basées sur divers facteurs propres à chaque candidat et aux exigences du poste.

JOB DESCRIPTION: 
 À propos d’Abbott 
 Abbott est un chef de file mondial de l’industrie des soins de santé qui crée des solutions scientifiques révolutionnaires visant à améliorer la santé des gens. L’entreprise est résolument tournée vers l’avenir, à l’affût des changements qui pourraient survenir dans le domaine des sciences et des technologies médicales.
 Être à l’emploi d’Abbott 
 En étant à l’emploi d’Abbott, vous pourrez faire un travail qui compte, vous perfectionner et apprendre, prendre soin de vous et des membres de votre famille, rester fidèle à ce que vous êtes et vivre pleinement. Vous pourrez :
 ·         profiter de possibilités d’avancement professionnel au sein d’une entreprise internationale qui vous permettra de bâtir la carrière dont vous rêvez;
 ·         travailler pour une entreprise reconnue dans des douzaines de pays partout dans le monde comme étant un excellent milieu de travail et figurant parmi les entreprises les plus admirées dans le monde dans le classement Fortune;
 ·         travailler pour une grande entreprise reconnue comme étant l’une des meilleures où travailler, notamment pour ce qui a trait à la diversité du personnel, à la conciliation travail-famille ainsi qu’à la place des femmes dans les postes de cadres et les postes scientifiques.
 L’occasion à saisir 
 Ce poste est basé à notre bureau à St-Laurent, au sein de la division Nutrition et nécessite une présence au bureau quatre jours par semaine, avec la possibilité de travailler à distance une journée.
 Ce que vous ferez 
 En tant que partenaire stratégique clé de l’entreprise, le Chef, Renseignements sur le marché, Alimentation thérapeutique (Ensure, Glucerna, Pedialyte et nombreux autres produits de spécialité) aura l’occasion d’influer directement sur la croissance de trois grandes catégories de produits. Il sera chargé de contribuer à l’élaboration des stratégies de commercialisation, d’influencer les décisions de tous les secteurs de l’entreprise – des activités de base à l’innovation –, et d’assurer une croissance profitable. Il devra générer et intégrer des renseignements issus de la compréhension des consommateurs, des professionnels de la santé et des concurrents afin de formuler des recommandations qui contribueront à l’atteinte des objectifs de croissance de l’entreprise.
 Le candidat idéal possède une grande curiosité lui permettant de débusquer des vérités profondes, de solides aptitudes pour l’analyse et la résolution de problèmes, ainsi qu’une grande débrouillardise et un souci du détail. Il connaît bien les méthodes de recherche et a la capacité éprouvée d’influencer les décisions de parties prenantes de différents services dans un environnement au rythme rapide.
 Renseignements qui génèrent de la valeur 
 ·         Déterminer les conséquences des décisions et la suite des choses en formulant des recommandations concrètes fondées sur une profonde compréhension des clients et des catégories de produits.
 ·         Être attentif à ce qui se passe à l’externe et en tirer des leçons. Chercher, découvrir et communiquer à l’interne les meilleures pratiques.
 ·         Diriger la création et la mise en œuvre du plan de formation approprié et adapté aux fins de la réalisation des stratégies et des objectifs d’affaires.
 Être la voix des consommateurs 
 ·         Représenter les clients et tenir l’entreprise au courant de leurs besoins et de leurs comportements.
 ·         Adopter un rythme de recherche permettant de répondre aux besoins non satisfaits, d’éliminer les obstacles à l’achat et de devancer les tendances.
 ·         Assurer la diffusion des données de base sur la santé et la valeur de la marque, en suivant le rendement par rapport aux objectifs.
 Contribution à la réussite commerciale 
 ·         Être un partenaire d’affaires stratégique pour les parties prenantes clés, du processus de planification aux activités mensuelles de planification des ventes et de l’exploitation.
 ·         Assurer l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux en repérant les occasions d’affaires et les possibilités d’accroître les parts de marché.
 ·         Veiller à l’adoption par tous de buts et objectifs communs permettant d’assurer la réussite commerciale.
 ·         Posséder la flexibilité et la créativité nécessaires pour prendre en compte les priorités changeantes et surmonter les défis commerciaux.
 ·         Favoriser une solide relation avec l’équipe des Renseignements sur le marché d’Abbott Nutrition et de la filiale américaine afin de tirer profit des données pertinentes.
 Renforcement des capacités 
 ·         Entretenir les relations avec les fournisseurs et gérer le budget de recherche efficacement.
 ·         Gérer le budget et les besoins relatifs aux données de recherche secondaire fournies par Nielsen et IQVIA.
 ·         Demeurer au fait des méthodes et outils de recherche de pointe et simplifier les processus.
 Compétences requises

 ·         Au moins 8 ans d’expérience en matière d’étude de la clientèle et d’études de marché auprès des consommateurs et de l’industrie des soins de santé; expérience multifonctionnelle, un atout.
 ·         Maîtrise obligatoire des principes fondamentaux associés aux biens de consommation courante, des renseignements sur les clients et des méthodes de recherche personnalisées.
 ·         Expérience dans la gestion de sources de données Nielson, IQVIA un atout.
 ·         Expérience du soutien de la valorisation des marques (positionnement, architecture) et du processus de planification commerciale.
 ·         Capacité de composer avec l’ambiguïté, solide orientation sur les résultats et grand leadership.
 ·         Solides aptitudes pour l’analyse permettant de traduire les données en éclairages et en recommandations.
 ·         Faculté de diriger et de gérer plusieurs projets tout en respectant des délais serrés ou changeants.
 ·         Capacité de travailler efficacement avec de multiples équipes et aptitude éprouvée à tisser des partenariats efficaces.
 ·         Excellentes aptitudes pour la communication et la narration. Capacité d’exposer les renseignements découverts de manière engageante, innovante et frappante pour créer un récit simple et intéressant.
 ·         Le ou la titulaire du poste doit pouvoir bien communiquer en anglais (50% du temps), car ses fonctions exigent des interactions avec des intervenants et collègues se trouvant à l’extérieur du Québec ou du Canada.

 About Abbott

 Working at Abbott 
 At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

 ROLE: SENIOR, TALENT ACQUISITION PARTNER 
 TEAM: TALENT 
 LOCATION: TORONTO (HYBRID) 
 COMPANY OVERVIEW 
 Salt is a North American marketing agency that creates connected experiences through creative, digital & media innovation. 
 Our mission is to “Earn the World’s Attention” and Salt is built to find, develop, execute, and amplify the ideas that are worthy of our clients’ audiences. We’ve structured our agency to do what’s right for our clients – to connect different perspectives, to work across mediums, and to focus on delivering meaningful, effective results. 
 We’re committed to living up to the values in our name. “Salt of The Earth” means we value collaborative, humble, hard-working people here. We’re looking for people who are as smart as they are kind because we believe the right talent and the right culture help us do what’s right for our clients. 
 ROLE OVERVIEW 
 As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner , you are a trusted strategic partner responsible for leading full-cycle recruitment across key disciplines for Salt and The Kitchen North America. You combine relationship building, operational excellence, and data-driven insight to ensure we attract, hire, and retain the best talent in the market. 
 Reporting to the Director of Talent, you will play a central role in designing and refining Salt’s hiring practices, shaping our employer brand, and building inclusive pipelines for future growth. You balance hands-on execution with strategic foresight while managing high-priority searches while also mentoring others, improving systems, and helping define what great hiring looks like at Salt. 
 CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Talent Acquisition & Sourcing 
 Lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and specialized roles across Creative, Strategy, Media, Digital, and Operations. 
 Partner with department heads to forecast hiring needs and build proactive sourcing strategies that align with business growth. 
 Develop deep pipelines of diverse, high-performing candidates using advanced sourcing techniques, networking, and market research. 
 Ensure all job descriptions, postings, and outreach communications reflect Salt’s voice, culture, and inclusive values. 
 Coach and mentor Recruiters and hiring managers in sourcing methods, outreach communication, and candidate assessment. 
 Candidate Experience & Employer Brand 
 Own and elevate the candidate experience, ensuring transparency, respect, and consistency across every stage. 
 Lead training or enablement for hiring managers on structured interviewing, equitable evaluation, and feedback delivery. 
 Partner with Marketing and Talent leadership to develop employer brand initiatives, social content, and campaigns that strengthen Salt’s visibility and appeal. 
 Represent Salt and The Kitchen at industry events, panels, and partnerships to grow awareness and attract top-tier talent. 
 Regularly assess and improve the recruitment process to ensure a seamless and differentiated experience for all candidates. 
 Recruitment Analytics & Optimization 
 Maintain complete and accurate data within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to ensure reporting integrity. 
 Track key hiring metrics such as time-to-fill, offer acceptance rate, source effectiveness, and pipeline diversity. 
 Analyze data to identify recruitment trends and inform adjustments to sourcing strategy and process efficiency. 
 Present insights and recommendations to the Director of Talent and Leadership teams to guide workforce planning. 
 Drive adoption of standardized tools, templates, and metrics that increase clarity and accountability across the recruiting team. 
 Strategic Partnership & Stakeholder Influence 
 Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and hiring managers, guiding them through workforce planning and hiring strategy. 
 Lead intake and calibration meetings to define role expectations, success criteria, and interview structures. 
 Provide regular updates on search progress, pipeline health, and market conditions to align expectations and inform decisions. 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with People & Culture, Finance, and Resource Management to align recruitment activity with organizational priorities and headcount plans. 
 Influence stakeholders through data, insight, and relationship building — ensuring that decisions are timely, informed, and inclusive. 
 Early Talent & Engagement Programs 
 Lead the development and delivery of early talent programs, including campus outreach, internships, and entry-level recruitment initiatives. 
 Partner with People & Culture to ensure early talent experiences are structured, developmental, and aligned to long-term hiring goals. 
 Build relationships with schools, professional associations, and community organizations to expand Salt’s early talent pipeline. 
 Track early talent program metrics, conversion rates, and participant outcomes to refine future recruitment strategies. 
 Champion initiatives that strengthen Salt’s connection to future creative, digital, and marketing professionals. 
 EXPERIENCE & SKILLS: 
 5–7 years of experience in full-cycle recruitment or talent acquisition, ideally within a creative, digital, or integrated agency environment. 
 Proven success managing senior-level searches and leading multiple high-volume or specialized hiring initiatives simultaneously. 
 Expertise in sourcing diverse candidates using advanced research, networking, and digital tools. 
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels of the organization. 
 Experience using ATS platforms and analytics tools to track, interpret, and present recruitment data and insights. 
 Demonstrated ability to design or improve recruiting processes that increase speed, quality, and consistency. 
 Strong understanding of employer branding and experience partnering with marketing or communications to amplify brand presence. 
 Leadership experience mentoring recruiters, hiring partners, or cross-functional stakeholders. 
 Passion for developing early talent and fostering inclusive, equitable hiring practices. 
 Proactive, organized, and adaptable, thriving in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly. 
 PERKS & BENEFITS THAT SET US APART 
 We don’t just talk about balance, growth, and culture, we build for it: 
 Work-Life Flexibility: Hybrid setup, up to 28 paid days off and winter holiday shutdowns 
 Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, and vision plans, plus Salt Bucks to spend on what matters to you—wellness, RRSPs, or extra time off. 
 Growth-Driven Culture: Dedicated Salt Days, top-tier learning access, and formal leadership development. 
 Celebration-First Mentality: Legendary team trips, seasonal socials, and Salt Swag that reps your squad. 
 Real Rewards: Referral and new business bonuses, exclusive lifestyle perks, and personalized wellness options. 
 Culture of Belonging: DEI programs, active ERGs, and a workplace where every voice counts. 
 WHAT WE STAND FOR 
 Salt of the Earth: We lead with humility, honesty, and heart—always. 
 Do What’s Right: No shortcuts. We choose integrity over ease, every time. 
 Earn Your Salt: We roll up our sleeves, chase results, and celebrate the journey. 
 Make Things Better: We’re solution-seekers, always pushing for smarter ways forward. 
 Seek Different Perspectives: Diversity fuels our thinking. Inclusion drives our impact. 
 The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $90,000–$115,000. Individual compensation within this range is determined based on job-related factors such as experience, skills, level of responsibility, internal equity, and business needs. This range represents the expected base salary for this role and does not include other elements of SALT’s total rewards program. 
Salt XC is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and to attracting and retaining the most qualified employees regardless of race, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, age or disability.

Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Marketing at Brex 
 The Marketing team tells the Brex story — turning product innovation into customer obsession. We develop messaging, shape the brand, and bring our platform to life through thoughtful, compelling content. Our team spans Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Business Development, and Design to drive growth and build trust.
 What you’ll do 
 Brex is seeking a deeply analytical, growth-rooted Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own, scale, and optimize our Paid Social engine, with Meta as the core growth driver and a clear mandate to test and scale emerging channels.
 In this role, you will be accountable for down-funnel pipeline, efficient CAC, and customer acquisition. You won't just optimize campaigns; you will engineer signal architecture, build scalable audience models, and establish a high-velocity creative testing engine. Critically, you know how to build brand through a performance lens, connecting upper-funnel investments to near-term impact and long-term value creation. You’ll help accelerate Brex’s growth by scaling what works, continuously improving how we operate, and unlocking new opportunities for impact.
 Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Team members are expected to work in-office three days per week (Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays). Brex also offers the flexibility to work remotely for up to four weeks per year, in one-week increments.
 Responsibilities 
 Growth & Pipeline Ownership: Own Meta + emerging channel budgets, CAC efficiency, conversion, and downstream pipeline/revenue across self-serve and sales-led motions.
 Signal & Measurement Strategy: Partner with Data and Marketing Ops to improve conversion signals, CAPI, and offline conversion tracking, enabling platforms to optimize toward higher-quality customers.
 Structured Experimentation: Build and execute a continuous, hypothesis-driven testing framework across audiences, bidding strategies, optimization events, landing pages, and creative concepts; document learnings to turn paid social into a predictable acquisition channel.
 Full-Funnel Growth: Build paid social strategies that create demand at the top of the funnel and efficiently convert it through retargeting and lower-funnel programs.
 Creative Strategy: Translate performance data into creative hypotheses and partner with Brand and Design to test, iterate, and scale winning concepts.
 Audience Strategy: Use first-party data, intent signals, modeled audiences, lookalikes, and platform automation to identify and scale high-value audiences.
 Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Analytics, Marketing Ops, Field / Events team, PMM, and Sales to connect paid social performance & programs to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes.
 Requirements 
 5+ years of growth or performance marketing experience, with deep hands-on expertise managing and scaling Meta as a primary acquisition channel.
 Demonstrated experience owning a paid social channel end to end, including strategy, budgets, forecasting, campaign architecture, optimization, and performance reporting.
 Relentlessly analytical: Deep understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback periods), attribution modeling, and how to connect platform metrics directly to down-funnel business impact.
 Experience running full-funnel paid social programs, from awareness/video and demand generation through conversion and pipeline.
 Strong expertise in audience strategy and platform automation, including first-party audiences, lookalikes, broad targeting, retargeting, and automated campaign products.
 Strong understanding of conversion signals and measurement, including Meta CAPI, server-side tracking, attribution, conversion-event strategy, and CRM/offline conversion data.
 Demonstrated experience building structured experimentation roadmaps across creative, audiences, bidding, optimization events, and new platform capabilities.
 Strong creative judgment and experience writing briefs and translating performance data into actionable creative recommendations.
 Excellent communicator who can operate autonomously and influence cross-functional partners across Brand, PMM, Design, Analytics, Engineering, Marketing Ops, and Sales.
 Bonus Points 
 Experience in fin-tech marketing or marketing to finance professionals.
 Familiarity with product-led growth or hybrid demand models.
 Compensation 
 The expected salary range for this role is $116,000 - $116,750 CAD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
 Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.
 Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As an Account Executive on our SMB Sales team, you’ll own a territory of target accounts and existing customers with up to 1,000 employees. Your focus will be building new business, creating a healthy sales pipeline, and expanding customer relationships by connecting organizations with solutions that help protect access to the tools and information their teams rely on.



You’ll partner closely with Business Development Representatives (BDRs), Solutions, Channels, Onboarding, and Customer Success to deliver thoughtful, value-based sales experiences. 



Expectations of this role 

This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's Toronto office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days based on business needs.



How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.



What we're looking for:

 - 2+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in identity & security or privilege access management, with a focus on SMB or Mid Market accounts OR a top performing BDR with outbound experience and success ready to step up

 - A record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), with clear ownership of your results.

 - Experience building pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, inbound leads, networking, and account planning.

 - Experience managing both new business and expansion opportunities, including upselling and cross-selling within an existing book of business.

 - Strong solution-selling, negotiation, forecasting, presentation, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make technical concepts accessible to non-technical audiences.

 - The ability to understand and explain cybersecurity concepts, particularly Identity and Access Management (IAM), in the context of customer needs.

 - Preferred: Experience with MEDDPPICC or another structured qualification framework, as well as Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or Outreach.



What you can expect:

 - Own and grow a territory by identifying target accounts, developing an Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), and prioritizing opportunities based on customer needs and business potential.

 - Build and maintain pipeline through proactive prospecting, inbound follow-up, cold calling, networking, and consistent account planning.

 - Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets by developing, advancing, and closing new business opportunities.

 - Expand existing customer relationships by identifying relevant opportunities to introduce additional 1Password solutions, including Extended Access Management.

 - Use a structured sales process to understand customer priorities, uncover pain points, align solutions to business outcomes, and create clear mutual action plans.

 - Present to stakeholders and decision-makers, handle objections, and negotiate mutually beneficial outcomes.

 - Collaborate with internal teams and channel partners to support customer engagement, strengthen account health, and create shared growth opportunities.

 - Stay current on cybersecurity and Identity and Access Management trends, and use relevant tools—including artificial intelligence (AI) when appropriate—to prepare effectively and improve your sales practice.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $65,000 CAD and $91,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. The role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.



This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 



You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 



How we work with AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.



Our approach to work

We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.



What we offer

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🏝 Generous PTO policy 

💖 Four company-wide wellness days 

 Growth and future

Community

 Job Description 
LES Project Assistant - Co-op
 Job Summary
 Support the implementation and deployment of the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), with a primary focus on creating laboratory methods required for the Lab Execution System (LES).
 This role involves reviewing and learning existing laboratory methods, consulting with scientists who use these methods, and building and testing methods in a digital format using the SM-LES system.
 Essential Functions
 Create new laboratory methods as digital workflows in the SM-LES system, using existing paper-based laboratory methods as templates.
 Support the deployment of simple laboratory instruments and calibrations using the SM-LES system.
 Support the LIMS project by updating the electronic sample database for both analytical and microbiological laboratories. Activities may include stability studies, sample tracking, sample logging, and method workflows.
 Maintain detailed and accurate records in accordance with regulatory and user requirements.
 Follow all current Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and applicable procedures.
 Maintain a safe working environment and report potential hazards.
 Work with and advise staff regarding applicable administrative policies and procedures.
 Provide timely assistance to laboratory chemists and supervisors as requested.
 Support SampleManager deployment activities.
 Develop Work Instructions (WIs) related to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), as required.
 Required Qualifications
 Education
 High school diploma or General Educational Development (GED) Certificate required.
 Currently working toward a college diploma or university degree in Chemistry or a related field of study.
 Ability to commit to a 9–12 month co-op term is required.
 Experience
 No previous related experience required.
 Equivalency
 Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant work experience may be considered.
